description: Curated Drupal Core theme lineage for the 2026-11-12 investigation. Records describe package, code and product-scope relationships. They do not assign release applicability or conformance, and they do not inherit predecessor issues.

evidence.note: core/themes/claro/claro.info.yml is present at tag 8.8.0 and declares experimental: true.
The experimental flag is absent at 9.4.0. core/profiles/standard/config/install/system.theme.yml sets admin: claro.
Closed (fixed) issue 'Remove the Claro theme'; commit 8eaf82d7b4fa91973165b1a20f4520bdaeedec56 is contained in 12.0.0-beta1 and beta2.

verification.note: Checked against exact Git tags and a merge commit. No second human reviewer recorded.

limitations: The record does not establish that Claro code was adopted from the contributed claro project before 8.8.0.
The exact first 11.5 tag that deprecated Claro was not verified.

evidence.note: Present at 9.1.0 with experimental: true; absent at 9.0.0.
system.theme.yml sets default: olivero and admin: claro at 9.4.0. The experimental flag was already absent at 9.3.0.
Closed (fixed) issue 'Remove the Olivero theme'; commit 8d87e80272136cb5145655e01237dc6d5b9f358d is contained in 12.0.0-beta1 and beta2.

verification.note: Checked against exact Git tags. No second human reviewer recorded.

limitations: Presence and default status are verified; code origin before 9.1.0 is not.

evidence.note: Removal from Core; commit contained in 12.0.0-beta1 and beta2.
Contributed Claro 3.0.0 declares compatibility with Drupal ^11.5 || ^12.
Compared with https://git.drupalcode.org/project/claro/-/tree/3.0.0: 468 common relative paths, 419 byte-identical blobs (Git blob IDs), 49 changed paths, 23 core-only paths.

verification.note: Tag, release and blob-ID comparison performed; no second human reviewer recorded.

limitations: Tree comparison proves code continuity, not that every historical issue still reproduces.
Contributed issue tracker state is separate from the Core queue and was not inherited.

evidence.note: Removal from Core; commit contained in 12.0.0-beta1 and beta2.
Contributed Olivero 2.0.0 declares compatibility with Drupal ^11.4 || ^12.
Compared with https://git.drupalcode.org/project/olivero/-/tree/2.0.0: 300 common relative paths, 265 byte-identical blobs, 35 changed paths, 3 core-only paths.

verification.note: Tag, release and blob-ID comparison performed; no second human reviewer recorded.

limitations: 2.0.0 contains 68 paths absent from the 11.4.12 Core copy; these are not individually reviewed.
Issue transfer from the Core queue to the contributed queue was not performed automatically.

evidence.note: Closed (fixed) 'Merging Gin as Admin theme'; the issue provides the merge request for Gin in Core under the name 'admin'.
Core issue summary states: 'The Default Admin theme is basically Gin renamed. Gin used Claro as a base theme, and that structure was flattened when it was added to core.'
Drupal Core blog, 20 June 2025: core will adopt Gin and remove Claro from the next major version.

Compared with https://git.drupalcode.org/project/gin/-/tree/6.x: 460 common relative paths, 230 byte-identical blobs, 230 changed paths. With Gin 5.0.16 the overlap is only 41 paths / 6 identical blobs, so Gin 5.x is not a safe code proxy for Default Admin.

verification.note: Issue text, blog, tag presence and blob-ID comparison checked; no second human reviewer recorded.

limitations: Adoption grants no automatic inheritance of Gin accessibility issues. Each issue needs independent applicability evidence.
The exact Gin commit merged into Core was not reconstructed; Core's merge commit is the authoritative code state.

evidence.note: Closed (fixed) 'Rename Gin-based admin theme': change theme name from 'Admin' to 'Default Admin' and machine name from 'admin' to 'default_admin'.

verification.note: Explicit in the core issue; no independent code diff reviewed.

limitations: The short-lived 'admin' machine name is not a shipped Core release target in this repository.

evidence.note: Claro CSS was copied en masse into Default Admin when Gin's Claro base theme was flattened; the issue tracks untangling the two CSS trees.
Describes overlapping token systems from the 'Seven -> Claro -> Gin' lineage.
Compared with Core 11.4.12 claro: 303 common relative paths, 136 byte-identical blobs, 167 changed paths.

verification.note: Issue text and blob-ID comparison checked; no second human reviewer recorded.

limitations: Shared code is not shared defect. Claro issues require per-issue verification against Default Admin.
